ReLU6 activation: min(max(x, 0), 6)

ReLU with a ceiling: 0 below 0, x up to 6, 6 above. MobileNetV1 and MobileNetV2 use it after every convolution. Same as torch.nn.ReLU6.

## Usage

```text
Conv2D -> BatchNorm -> ReLU6
```

```text
Keeps activations in a small range, which suits low-precision and mobile networks.
```

## Tips

- MobileNetV1 and MobileNetV2 blocks (Conv2D -> BatchNorm -> ReLU6)
- A pretrained network whose weights were trained with ReLU6.
